gameover.title: GAME OVER
gameover.restart_note: The campaign restarts from the beginning.
final.line1: Zeriko falls. The cage-lantern shatters on the stone floor.
final.line2: The light trapped inside rises. It takes on shoulders, hands, a tired face.
final.line3: "Aurora." The name leaves Koliani before she thinks it.
final.line4: "You really came," her mother says. "I knew you would."
final.line5: They leave together through the last door. Outside it is still night — but now it is their night.
endcard.text:
The last door gives way.
Koliani finds her mother.

— the end of what exists for now —
map.title: WORLD MAP
clue.floresta_sinal_da_porta.title: The smell on the door
clue.floresta_sinal_da_porta.body: The door still smells of his sulphur. She came through here — and not alone.
clue.floresta_carta_rasgada.title: Half a letter
clue.floresta_carta_rasgada.body: Half a letter from mother, torn down the middle: "...don't come after me, Kol. It isn't me he wants..."
clue.pantano_bilhete_na_agua.title: A note in the reeds
clue.pantano_bilhete_na_agua.body: A scrap of paper snagged on the reeds, the ink half-eaten by the poison: "...he keeps the lantern on him. Always. Even asleep..."
clue.ninho_teia_com_cabelo.title: A hair in the web
clue.ninho_teia_com_cabelo.body: A long chestnut hair wound into the web, the same as mother's. She was carried through here — bound, not walking.
clue.arvore_lagrima_no_tronco.title: Sap over a handprint
clue.arvore_lagrima_no_tronco.body: The acid sap has run down the trunk and set hard over a handprint pressed into the bark — small, splayed, desperate. Caught in the resin, a thread of the same grey cloak from the swamp.
clue.coracao_batida_no_chao.title: The beat is a lullaby
clue.coracao_batida_no_chao.body: The pulse under your feet isn't random — it's the rhythm mother used to tap on your back to put you to sleep. The rot took it from her. She came through here alive, and it was listening.
clue.fornalha_marca_do_ferreiro.title: The smith's work order
clue.fornalha_marca_do_ferreiro.body: Nailed to the bellows, an order in Zeriko's own hand: shackles and a collar, forged to a woman's measure. The wrist size is written out. It matches the handprint in the tree.
clue.execucoes_lista_de_nomes.title: The roll of the condemned
clue.execucoes_lista_de_nomes.body: A ledger chained to the block, every name scratched through as its sentence was carried out. One near the end is not crossed out — only ringed, with a word beside it: ‘kept’. The name is Aurora.
clue.mortos_irmao_mais_novo.title: The younger brother's urn
clue.mortos_irmao_mais_novo.body: The two who guard this hall were jailers once — brothers. The younger kept a scrap of cloth in his urn, torn from a green cloak, and a line: ‘She asked me to tell her daughter she walked out on her own feet.’ Zeriko had them both killed for letting her rest.
clue.cela_zero_o_primeiro.title: The first to try
clue.cela_zero_o_primeiro.body: Scratched into the Cell Zero grate, in a soldier's hand: ‘I came for a brother. I reached the throne. I turned at the last step.’ The one bound here fought Zeriko before your grandmother was born. He tests everyone who comes this far — the ones who love someone enough to keep walking, he lets pass. He let Aurora pass.
clue.cela_zero_porta_aberta.title: He stands aside
clue.cela_zero_porta_aberta.body: The First Prisoner lowers the sword that looks so much like yours. ‘She didn't flinch at the door. Neither did you.’ Beyond, the ground tilts upward — the Forgotten Towers, and cold air that smells of bells.
clue.sinos_badalada_familiar.title: A note she knew
clue.sinos_badalada_familiar.body: One bell answers lower than the rest. Around its rim, names cast in the bronze — climbers who reached the top. The last is not cast but scratched, fresh: Aurora. She rang it on her way through. The keeper says a rung bell here means ‘let her pass, and say nothing to Zeriko.’
clue.ventos_pena_marcada.title: The marked feather
clue.ventos_pena_marcada.body: Aerion never lands and never lets anyone past on foot -- the currents are his, the platforms are his. A wing feather is caught in the rail, and someone has inked a small mark on its shaft: the same mark that is on every clue you have found, a folded green cloak. He carried her up the last stretch himself, on the wind, and set her down at the top. Then he went back to guarding an empty sky.
clue.tempestade_cajado_de_osso.title: A splinter of the staff
clue.tempestade_cajado_de_osso.body: Voltaris was Zeriko's storm-warden — he raised the tempest so no one could climb. A bone splinter from his staff, still warm: he aimed every bolt at Aurora and missed on purpose, every time. Scratched on it: ‘She had my daughter's way of not looking down.’
clue.lunar_carta_da_sacerdotisa.title: The tide-reader's letter
clue.lunar_carta_da_sacerdotisa.body: The Priestess reads the moon for Zeriko — every climber's path shows in the tides before they take it. She saw Aurora's and said nothing. Folded into the letter, a moon-chart with one line traced in silver: a woman walking out of the castle, not carried. ‘The pull was already turning back toward the door. I only had to not stop it.’
clue.pico_escama_de_vyrak.title: The old scale
clue.pico_escama_de_vyrak.body: Vyrak is the last thing Zeriko set on the road up. A shed scale, scarred underneath by a collar older than the demon. Aurora climbed here and spoke its name — the one from before the chain. The dragon lay down and let her walk over its neck to the far side. It has been waiting to be asked again.
clue.pico_torres_para_tras.title: Everything behind you
clue.pico_torres_para_tras.body: From the summit door the whole climbed road lies behind — forest, prison, three towers, all small now. Ahead the mountain ends and the ground opens downward into cold air with no bottom to it. Aurora's route turns here and goes down. The Abyss Catacombs.
clue.catacumbas_coroa_partida.title: The broken crown
clue.catacumbas_coroa_partida.body: The Bone King ruled here before Zeriko's grandfather. He put something in the ground under his own tomb and died guarding it — the demon's power was dug up from below, and he tried to bury it again. His crown lies snapped in two. Wedged in the break, a strip of green cloth and four words: ‘The queen went down.’
clue.ossos_placa_do_colosso.title: The muster plaque
clue.ossos_placa_do_colosso.body: Every bone in the Colossus belonged to someone who came down for the thing in the Abyss and didn't come back up. A brass plaque lists them, hundreds of names, filled in over centuries. The last line was started and scratched out: ‘Auror—’. The pile could not keep her. She went past it.
clue.velas_rosario_da_freira.title: The rosary of small mercies
clue.velas_rosario_da_freira.body: A thousand candles, one per soul in Zeriko's ledger. The Nun tends them — and has been snuffing them one by one for years, so quietly the demon never counts. Aurora's candle isn't in the rows. It's in a wind-sheltered niche behind the altar, still lit. On the ledger she reads as ‘held.’ She left months ago.
clue.serpente_idolo_partido.title: The split idol
clue.serpente_idolo_partido.body: Naga Zeraph guards the temple road for Zeriko, but the temple is older than him. A serpent idol here is split down the middle — done from inside, with a blade. In the hollow, a green thread and a scale prised loose: someone unhooked the tongue-latch that seals the far door, from within, and walked through. Only the keeper knows that latch. She let Aurora out.
clue.abismo_o_que_esta_la_em_baixo.title: What the Eye guards
clue.abismo_o_que_esta_la_em_baixo.body: The Eye has no body and no name of its own — it is a lid. Zeriko's power was never his; it was pulled up out of this pit and the Eye keeps watch so nothing more comes through, and no one goes down to look. It let Aurora past on one condition, scratched in the rock: that she not look down. She kept walking. She didn't look.
clue.abismo_saida_para_a_cidade.title: Up into the light
clue.abismo_saida_para_a_cidade.body: The far door of the Abyss opens on stairs going up — a long climb, and then a smell of smoke and iron and too many people. Aurora went this way. Above is the Corrupted City, where Zeriko's magic wears everyone's face.
clue.vila_retrato_sem_cara.title: The painted-over gallery
clue.vila_retrato_sem_cara.body: Two hundred years of mayors on the town-hall wall, every face scraped smooth and repainted blank. One canvas at the back is newer and untouched: a woman in a green cloak, face and all. The Faceless Mayor tried to wear her to pass Zeriko's inspections and couldn't hold it — you can only copy someone who's near. She was already gone.
clue.mercado_gancho_vazio.title: The empty hook
clue.mercado_gancho_vazio.body: The Butcher hangs everything Zeriko sends him on a numbered hook. One hook, low on the rail, has a tag but nothing on it — number filled in, weight left blank. In his ledger, beside it: 'brought in green, would not stay on the hook, walked out the delivery door.' He didn't chase her. He just wrote it down.
clue.trem_bilhete_so_ida.title: A one-way ticket
clue.trem_bilhete_so_ida.body: The Deathtrain only sells one-way tickets to Zeriko's castle; nobody rides it back. Wedged in a seat cushion, a stub torn the wrong way — return half kept, outbound half gone. Someone rode in and then walked the tracks out on foot the other direction. Punch marks in the green thread caught in the buckle. She didn't wait for a stop.
clue.catedral_registo_de_almas.title: The soul register
clue.catedral_registo_de_almas.body: The Bishop keeps Zeriko's soul register on the lectern — one line per person taken, signed by the Bishop's own hand. Aurora's line is there, dated, but the signature space is blank: he started the pen-stroke and stopped. In the margin, small: 'she was already at the door. I let the ink dry.' Behind the broken window, real daylight.
clue.praca_o_que_ela_diz.title: What the Bride says
clue.praca_o_que_ela_diz.body: She was queen here before the city was corrupted. Zeriko married her to the eclipse and cut her open on the square to pry the Abyss ajar — that is where his power comes from. Bound to the black sun, she still fights whoever comes. But when her veil burns off, between the blows, she talks. She says: 'Your mother stood exactly where you are and I could not stop myself hurting her either. She forgave me on the way past. Go. The door is his throne room. He is smaller than the room.'
clue.praca_para_o_castelo.title: The last gate before him
clue.praca_para_o_castelo.body: Past the square the road ends at Zeriko's gate. Everything Aurora walked through is behind: forest, prison, towers, catacombs, this whole grey city. The trail of small mercies — a jailer, a mage, a nun, a bishop, a dead queen — all of them let her pass, none of them told him. He does not know she is already out. He is still holding a door on an empty room.
clue.portoes_estandarte_rasgado.title: The torn standard
clue.portoes_estandarte_rasgado.body: The Black Captain guards the gate the way a good soldier guards a gate: he lets no one in. He does not check who leaves. His own standard hangs torn at the bottom edge, cut cleanly by someone walking out under it without stopping. He never reported it. A gate guard who watches the wrong direction is still, technically, at his post.
clue.espelhos_o_que_ve.title: What the mirror shows
clue.espelhos_o_que_ve.body: The Hall of Mirrors shows each visitor the version of themselves Zeriko can use: the one that turns back, the one that stays. Aurora's mirror is cracked from the inside — the reflection refused to stand still for him and broke the glass getting out. Whatever the dark shape here wears your face for, it is a leftover. The real one already walked through her own reflection and kept going.
clue.banquete_o_lugar_vazio.title: The set-aside seat
clue.banquete_o_lugar_vazio.body: The Devouring King eats whatever Zeriko puts on the table, guests included, and grows. One seat near the head is laid but roped off: full setting, chair pushed back, a card with a name. He was told to keep it ready. Aurora sat there once, ate nothing, left before the courses. He has kept the place for months out of habit. The King forgets nothing he has swallowed and cannot let go of the one meal that walked away.
clue.coracao_o_arauto.title: Never one voice
clue.coracao_o_arauto.body: The Herald speaks for Zeriko and changes shape to match whichever part of him is speaking: the knight who took the throne, the demon he fed on to keep it, the raw magic that is all that is left underneath. When it falls it says the thing it was built to hide: 'He was never one. He is a committee of hungers wearing a crown. There is no him to beat -- only the room, and how much of it he has convinced you is real.' Aurora heard this too. She did not stop to argue.
clue.trono_o_que_sobra.title: The throne room, arriving
clue.trono_o_que_sobra.body: The room does not hold still. Bits of everywhere you have been surface and sink again -- rotted roots, a hanging chain, a bell with no clapper, a wall of names, a market hook, a black sun. Zeriko built his hall out of what he has taken and cannot let go. Somewhere near the middle there is a chair, and a woman's shape half-drawn beside it in the dust, walking away. It has not finished being real yet. That is the fight.
clue.prisao_carta_na_cela.title: The empty cell
clue.prisao_carta_na_cela.body: In a cell at the far end, her name scratched into the stone and a date — three days ago. Zeriko didn't keep her here long.
clue.prisao_grito_nas_correntes.title: Chains still swinging
clue.prisao_grito_nas_correntes.body: The chains of a high cell are still swinging. Whoever passed through did so just now — and by force.
clue.torres_lanterna_de_zeriko.title: The lantern in the distance
clue.torres_lanterna_de_zeriko.body: Between two broken towers, far off, a light that is no star: Zeriko's cage-lantern. Inside it, a silhouette.
clue.torres_sussurro_da_mae.title: A whisper on the wind
clue.torres_sussurro_da_mae.body: Behind the cracked wall, scratched in haste: "He's saving me for last, Kol. Get there before that."
clue.castelo_aurora_livre.title: Aurora
clue.castelo_aurora_livre.body: The cage-lantern is shattered. Mother — Aurora — is free. They leave together through the last door.

dlg.primeiro.intro.1: I came for a brother. I reached the throne. I turned at the last step.
dlg.primeiro.intro.2: Everyone who gets this far, I test. Show me you would keep walking.
dlg.primeiro.win.1: She did not flinch at the door. Neither did you. Go.
dlg.noiva.intro.1: I waited at the altar until the sun went out. He never came.
dlg.noiva.intro.2: If I cannot have my day, no one crosses this square with hope in their chest.
dlg.noiva.win.1: ...Your mother wore that same look. Go on. The veil is already ash.
dlg.arauto.intro.1: I speak for Zeriko. Which of him would you like to die to?
dlg.arauto.intro.2: Knight, demon, or the hunger underneath -- pick, and I will wear it.
dlg.arauto.win.1: He was never one. Only the room, and how much of it you believe.
dlg.zeriko.intro.1: You are the third of your blood to stand here. The other two I keep.
dlg.zeriko.intro.2: Aurora is behind that door. Come and open it.
dlg.zeriko.win.1: The room... it is not holding...
dlg.zeriko.win.2: She was already gone. I was holding a door on an empty room.

shrine.title: SANCTUARY
mec.saltos.txt: Platforms climb in tight zigzags. Chain the jumps and use the double jump to save a bad one.
mec.gruta.txt: The ceiling drops: go down into the tunnel and back up. Stalactites fall — keep moving.
mec.trampolim.txt: Bounce pads throw you about one and a half double jumps high. Aim before you land on them.
mec.espinhos.txt: The low lane is a spike bed you can pogo across; the high lane is the safe, tighter route.
mec.ritmo.txt: These platforms appear and vanish on a beat. Read the rhythm and cross without stopping.
mec.alavanca.txt: A gate blocks the hall. Hit the lever on the perch to open it — once open, it stays open.
mec.fogo.txt: Jets burst from the floor on a fixed cycle. Cross in the gap, not on the flame.
mec.guilhotinas.txt: Blades drop on a fixed beat and pull back slowly. Wait for the lift, then run under.
mec.arena.txt: Solid ground over the void and enemies on it. Nothing moves on until the room is clear.
mec.prensa.txt: Walls sweep the hall out of phase. There is no ceiling — wait for the gap or jump the wall.
mec.sinos.txt: The bridge is a ghost until you strike the bell. Hit it as often as you need.
mec.vento.txt: A column of rising air lifts you far past a normal jump. Enter it and steer.
mec.serras.txt: Saws run along rails above and below the platforms. Jump on their beat.
mec.gravidade.txt: Inside this field you weigh less: jumps go higher and falls take longer.
mec.torre.txt: A tight zigzag climb that gains a lot of height. Every step is within one jump.
mec.elevador.txt: Slabs ride up and down on their own. Board them and step off at the top.
mec.quebra.txt: These platforms fall a moment after you touch them. Never stand still.
mec.velas.txt: The bridge is only solid while a candle burns near it. Touch a dead candle to light it.
mec.pedras.txt: Rocks drop from the ledge above — some when you get close, some on a cycle. Watch what shakes.
mec.poco.txt: A funnel down to the deadly liquid and back up the far wall. Descend hugging the walls.
mec.cripta.txt: A closed room with an inner wall to clear and rocks coming down. Short vertical work.
mec.pendulos.txt: Hanging blades swing across the platforms, each out of phase. Cross one swing at a time.
mec.ferry.txt: One platform crosses the gap back and forth. Ride it standing and dodge the hanging blades.
mec.segredo.txt: A sealed alcove holds essence. Only Wall Breaking opens it — it is reward, never the path.
mec.pilares.txt: Jump from pillar top to pillar top with the void below. Only the caps are solid.
mec.crossfire.txt: Turrets on both sides fire straight through the path at alternating heights. Move between shots.
mec.espelhos.txt: Tall mirrors block the way. One hit breaks each — and each releases a reflection to fight.
mec.forquilha.txt: The path splits and rejoins. The high route is short and dangerous, the low one long and safe.
mec.impulso.txt: A horizontal blast shoves you forward. Use the islets inside it to keep control.
mec.portal.txt: Step into one and come out the other. There is also a platform route — pick either.
mec.correntes.txt: Platforms hang on chains: some swing, some ride up and down. Time your step.
mec.corredor.txt: The ceiling is low — a jump means a bumped head — and saws run the rails. Run or roll.
mec.martelos.txt: Two rows of hammers strike off-beat: when one is down, the other is up. Walk the offbeat.
mec.bombas.txt: Bombs rain from above and mark the ground before they land. Read the marks and move.
mec.lava_sobe.txt: The deadly liquid climbs behind you. There is no waiting on this climb.
mec.mare.txt: The liquid rises and falls slowly over a low run of platforms. There is always a way — wait for it.
mec.grav_baixa.txt: Everything weighs less here. Jumps go much higher and you fall much slower.
mec.ar.txt: Underwater the clock is yours: air runs out. The bubble pockets refill it — they are few.
mec.tapete.txt: The water drags you sideways. Swim across the pull, not against it.
mec.escuro.txt: Night closes in with only a hole of light around you. You see the next step and nothing more.
mec.gelo.txt: Slippery plates: the jump is the same, the braking is gone. The problem is stopping, not jumping.
mec.chuva.txt: A wall of snow chases you down the run. It cannot be fought — only outrun.
mec.vitral.txt: A glass wall blocks the way and the bridge beyond is a ghost. Break the glass to let the light through.
mec.espectral.txt: They only turn solid a few seconds after you step on them. There is no going back.
mec.frio.txt: Icy gusts leave you slowed for a few seconds after you leave them. It follows you out.
mec.areia.txt: It pulls you down and holds. Jump repeatedly to get out — walking will not do it.
mec.placa.txt: Standing on the plate opens the gate — and releases it the moment you step off.
mec.veneno.txt: The clouds mark you and the damage comes after. Running through still costs — the clean route is above.
mec.areia_no_ar.txt: The storm does not darken — it veils. You see everything, and everything badly.
mec.queda.txt: A stone ball comes down the run behind you. Run forward — there is no dodging it.
mec.rosas.txt: Thorns grow and retract on a cycle. The floor is only floor for part of the beat.
mec.bifurcacao.txt: Several mouths, and only one goes on. The false ones show themselves — read before you commit.
mec.gancho.txt: Hook onto the vines in mid-air and swing. Press jump to let go at the top of the arc.
mec.esporos.txt: Light and heavy fields alternate. Every jump changes weight — read the field before you leap.
mec.raizes.txt: Roots telegraph, then strike out of the ground. Watch the tell and be gone before it lands.
mec.engrenagens.txt: Cross arms turn slowly. Ride an arm while it is low and step off before it rises.
mec.peso.txt: They sink while you stand on them and rise when you leave. You lose height, not ground.
mec.replicantes.txt: Kill one and it splits into smaller ones. Space is the resource — do not get surrounded.
mec.circuito.txt: Switches must be lit in the right order. Get one wrong and the run resets.
mec.imanes.txt: They pull you in mid-air. Your jump is no longer entirely yours — aim off the pull.
mec.orbita.txt: The platform travels in a circle and you ride it. Get on early, get off on the near side.
mec.para_raios.txt: Lightning falls in columns. Draw it onto the metal rod to open the way.
mec.asas.txt: Hold jump while falling to glide. It is not flight — it is falling slowly, and only downward.
mec.ameaca.txt: A wall of death crosses the room at a steady pace. It cannot be fought — keep moving.
mec.invertido.txt: Floor plates flip your gravity: you fall upward and walk the ceilings. You choose when to step on one.
mec.estatuas.txt: These figures only move while you are not looking at them. Turning away is the risk.
mec.sombra.txt: It walks your path three seconds late. It cannot be fought or shaken — just never double back.
mec.mente.txt: The scenery rewrites itself behind you. The critical path never changes — the way back does.
mec.caixas.txt: The plate opens the gate only while weighted. Push the crate onto it — there is no other way.
mec.ciclo.txt: Three identical mouths and only one leads on. The others send you back to the start.
mec.incorporeo.txt: Your blade passes through it. Only the projectile lands — keep your distance.
mec.mausoleu.txt: Statues that move unseen, inside darkness that hides them. Looking back is no longer free.
mec.ceifa.txt: A single line sweeps the whole arena. There is no corner to hide in — only timing.
mec.serpente.txt: A long body in continuous motion crossing the room. You do not memorise it — you read it.
mec.conves.txt: The floor stays under your feet but stops being level. You slide to the low side, and it changes.
mec.varredura.txt: A beam sweeps the corridor end to end. Move with it, never against it.
mec.pulsacao.txt: Every hazard in this room shares a single beat. Find it once and the room is solved.
mec.prensa_fogo.txt: Presses that also burn. The gap is still there — it is just shorter than you want.
mec.brasas.txt: The floor lights up under anything that stands still. Keep walking and it never catches.
mec.correnteza.txt: The blood flows one way and takes you with it. Cross the current at an angle.
mec.reflexo.txt: The mirror does not break — it fights. It mirrors your moves and meets you in the middle.
mec.anel.txt: A ring of ground over lava. There are no corners — you can always be flanked.
mec.olhar.txt: The middle platforms exist only while you face them. Walking forward lights the way.
mec.sem_chao.txt: There is no floor here — only what the blasters give you. Ride them and never stall.
mec.gemea.txt: The same room twice, and the second time one thing is different. Find it before it finds you.
mec.atoleiro.txt: The ground sinks while you are on it and steals your speed. Standing still is going down.
mec.catapulta.txt: Stones fall from the sky and mark the ground first. The marks are your only warning.
mec.salvas.txt: Arrows come in waves, all at once, and every wave is telegraphed. Move between volleys.
mec.ariete.txt: The door only opens if you push the ram to it — and the ram is your only cover.
mec.assalto.txt: Climb while they shoot at you. Height is the goal, cover is what you steal on the way.
mec.horda.txt: Waves of enemies with the count in plain sight. Hold the ground until the counter runs out.
mec.memoria.txt: No danger here. This is the realm as it was, before Zeriko — walk it.
mec.revisao.txt: Four chambers from four regions, back to back, with nothing between them.
mec.provacao.txt: Three rooms, and in each one something of yours is missing. The room is not harder — you are less.
